description: Your comments, understood - inside Power BI. Put a column of comments, reviews or survey answers in the visual and get a word cloud that finally works: it splits the text itself, merges word forms, removes stop words in 18 languages and keeps every word in its place when you filter. With premium it becomes text analytics: phrases, the comments behind every word, group comparison and themes. Nothing leaves your report - no external calls, no AI service, no privileges. A cloud that stays put. Filter the page and the words that remain keep their positions; new words fill the gaps. You see what changed, not a reshuffled picture. The same data always gives the same cloud. Free features (no license needed, no time limit): Word cloud from raw comments (tokenized in the visual) or from ready-made terms with a weight measure. Reads the first 30,000 comments, and a note says so if there were more. Ready-made terms from Power Query have no row limit Word forms merged and labelled with a real word: price, prices and pricing count as one word; words typed without accents merge into the accented form Stop words built in for 18 languages, detected per comment; custom stop words with wildcards; a stop-word measure that needs no relationship Sentiment colouring: each word takes the tone of the sentences that mention it, or use your own sentiment measure from upstream.
